policy: Read-only source triage. Probabilities are signals, not proofs. No source/index/git changes, issues, builds or tests. Actual findings require focused regressions before implementation.

files.summary: Current code resolves native acceptance before queue eligibility, revision, preview and mutable business checks; exact retry replays the admitted acknowledgment. Current restricted visibility remains an intentional read boundary.
Existing tombstone retry resolves before visible revision guard; executor rechecks source relationship revision and retries bounded source races. No concrete duplicate-removal defect found.

Receiver verifies exact accepted request resolution source, frozen admitted child membership, receiving owner/program/generation, source pinned fact and resource revision; unavailable content waits, corruption refuses, and refusal aborts/fences. No missing path established by score.

No concrete recovery defect found: business completion blockers and content preparation run only when native acceptance is absent; executor resolves exact replay and later closure process pins complete independent item heads.

Read-only preview validates projection rows against immutable staged rows, binds cursor to batch revision/source position/publication cut, and rechecks source unchanged after composition. No concrete recovery mutation defect found.

Lost-response retry can fail after an unrelated application revision: handler reloads current endpoint revisions, but existing relationship records old endpoint revisions and RecordRelationship rejects the identical request against different revisions. This path lacks immutable authored command acceptance. Double hydration also does not hold target currentness through source append.

Accepted independent population export owner/process migration remains incomplete: current full-state owner stores export histories and emits snapshots, including RecordExport on population revision. This is an implementation gap, not an external prerequisite.

Gap owns record/one closure/pair uniqueness with native logical acceptance; close requires own expected revision and newer/different verified source; accepted risk link admission serializes pair uniqueness and immutable intent on this owner. External proof checks belong to handlers; no concrete defect established in this owner.

ListAdvisorFeedback is IProgramReadRequest; handler additionally requires handoff ProgramId match, lists only handoff-admitted child IDs, and computes currentness from exact selected version resolver. No concrete authority bypass found.

Stable relationship identity retries resolve before visible revision guard; executor rechecks source relationship revision and bounds OCC retries. Current endpoint visibility is enforced before disclosure.

Current handler captures evidence and mutates retention before population export acceptance, then uses aggregate.Revision instead of an authored expected export-owner token. It has no durable export intent/process receipt covering partial execution. Accepted target contract assigns AuditPopulationExportProcess; preserve canonical source/digest checks when migrating.

Immutable staged-row corruption is classified transient by catching the integrity base type. With the new unavailable subtype, corrupt immutable content must remain permanent; otherwise retry cannot recover and process/clients may retry forever. Native acceptance/retry order itself is sound.
